forum.title: Identify this component?
forum.best_answer_content:
Welcome @ibrahimonurcaliskan, to the community!

the marking **FUQ** stands for the [SMCJ28A-TR](https://www.st.com/en/protections-and-emi-filters/smcj28a.html).

Hope that helps?

Regards

/Peter
